pattern_id: VerifyLeader OOM - notify list grows unbounded when futures not removed from repl.notify on error
description: BUG PATTERN: OOM caused by VerifyLeader notify list memory leak when node fails. DESCRIPTION: When a node fails, the VerifyLeader mechanism causes memory to grow unboundedly leading to OOM. The verifyLeader() function adds the verify future 'v' to repl.notify list for each replica. When heartbeat/AppendEntries returns error, 'v' is deleted from r.leaderState.notify but NOT removed from repl.notify. This causes the notify list to grow infinitely. ROOT CAUSE: Asymmetric cleanup - the future is tracked in two places (leaderState.notify and repl.notify) but only removed from one on error. The replication goroutine continues to hold references to completed/failed futures, preventing garbage collection. LESSON: In distributed systems with async notification patterns: 1) Track where futures/callbacks are registered and ensure symmetric cleanup; 2) When a future completes (success or failure), remove it from ALL tracking structures; 3) Use weak references or explicit lifecycle management for notification subscriptions; 4) Monitor memory usage under failure conditions - leaks often only manifest when nodes fail; 5) Consider using defer or RAII patterns to ensure cleanup happens on all code paths.
